## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION — Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology). Confirmations: strong sector breadth (>7/11) alongside major divergences across large caps (AAPL, META, TSLA showing 1W vs 1M mix) supports a CAUTION regime.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology leads: NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +29.38% | 1M: +23.06%) ABOVE TREND. Materials strong: NEM (1W: +20.56% | 1M: +19.16%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +15.30%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Energy weak: XOM (1W: -1.54% | 1M: +11.33%) CORRECTION, CVX (1W: -5.22% | 1M: +7.19%) CORRECTION. Utilities weak: VST (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -11.01%) BELOW TREND, SRE (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -11.35%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: PLTR (1W: +39.78% | 1M: +33.30%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +29.38% | 1M: +23.06%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +20.56% | 1M: +19.16%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +13.72% | 1M: -12.17%) RECOVERY, ORCL (1W: +13.21% | 1M: +2.30%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: VLO (1W: -4.66% | 1M: +6.48%) CORRECTION, F (1W: -4.77% | 1M: +2.72%) CORRECTION, MAR (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -4.98%) BELOW TREND, VST (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -11.01%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -5.22% | 1M: +7.19%) CORRECTION — Weakness concentrated in Energy/Utilities.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W movers: PLTR (1W: +39.78% | 1M: +33.30%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +29.38% | 1M: +23.06%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +20.56% | 1M: +19.16%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +13.72% | 1M: -12.17%) RECOVERY — note MAJOR DIVERGENCE among large caps (AAPL, META, TSLA) with mixed 1W vs 1M signals; treat as tactical, not structural.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech is strong but narrow: NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +1.43% | 1M: -0.91%) RECOVERY; Sector breadth: estimated 20/24 positive → Sector Strength, but concentration risk high.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials mixed but constructive: JPM (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: -0.99% | 1M: +4.11%) CORRECTION; Sector breadth: estimated 13/20 positive → Internal Rotation, favors selective cyclical exposures.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare shows internal rotation: JNJ (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +0.05%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -1.77% | 1M: -5.70%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: +3.21% | 1M: -2.57%) RECOVERY; Sector breadth: estimated 10/17 positive → Internal Rotation.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective Tech leaders and resilient Financials while reducing exposure to overcrowded small-cap tech run-ups; monitor big-cap divergences. Style: Growth/Momentum tilt but with caution given narrow leadership and mixed large-cap signals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: PLTR (1W: +39.78% | 1M: +33.30%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +29.38% | 1M: +23.06%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: CVS (1W: -8.36% | 1M: -6.34%) BELOW TREND, VST (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -11.01%) BELOW TREND, EOG (1W: -9.38% | 1M: +1.65%) CORRECTION.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology (Tech: est. 20/24 positive), Materials (Materials: est. 8/11 positive) and Industrials (Industrials: est. 12/15 positive). BEARISH: Energy (Energy: est. 3/10 positive), Utilities (Utilities: est. 3/10 positive), Real Estate (weak).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND — watch for resistance tests as momentum extends. AAPL (1W: +1.43% | 1M: -0.91%) RECOVERY — monitor follow-through above recent short-term highs. JPM (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND — watch for confirmation of financial leadership on macro cues.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
CAT (+80): CAT (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.09%) RECOVERY — bullish beat/outlook but 1M lagging, watch for sustained recovery. CVS (+60): CVS (1W: -8.36% | 1M: -6.34%) BELOW TREND — bullish guidance expansion but price falling → divergence. EOG (+60): EOG (1W: -9.38% | 1M: +1.65%) CORRECTION — positive results but near-term sell-off, watch supply-driven follow-through.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
BA (-45): BA (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +5.07%) ABOVE TREND — FAA inspections headline is bearish, price is diverging higher; monitor for delayed reaction. PANW (-65) and GILD (-55) flagged in news pile; cross-check price action before adjusting exposure.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with a Growth/Momentum tilt given narrow tech leadership and strong overall breadth. SHOP (1W: +29.38% | 1M: +23.06%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +39.78% | 1M: +33.30%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk: major divergence across large caps (AAPL, META, TSLA RECOVERY patterns) and several bullish news names trading lower (CVS), so monitor for trend breaks.
